title: contact.rs: maxChanges silently ignored without validation
description: kith-chat/src/contact.rs ChatContactChangesHandler line 443: the comment 'maxChanges is accepted but ignored in v1' is correct per the current design, but the field is accepted without any upper-bound check. RFC 8620 §5.6 requires that if maxChanges is smaller than the actual change count, hasMoreChanges must be set to true. The handler always returns hasMoreChanges=false. Consequence: a conformant JMAP client that sends maxChanges=5 on a store with 100 changes will silently receive a truncated response and believe there are no more changes. This will be a real bug when the contact list grows beyond trivial size.
